limitations: RAM checks run in DEV alongside serial builds, with recorded brief native pauses for build CPU time; their wall times are not speed measurements.
Initial four-token repetitive prompt understated resident expert coverage; retained as a narrow probe, not the stress result. Remaining narrow cases were operator-stopped, not guard failures.
Varied stress uses exactly 32168 deterministic synthetic IDs, (i*2654435761)%150000+1000.
Parked arm configures eight checkpoints and 2 GiB parked budget; raw completion has no chat-message turn boundaries and does not fill every possible turn-checkpoint slot.
API tokens_evaluated is the whole request length, whereas timings.prompt_n is NEW evaluated tokens. Do not subtract cache_n from timings.prompt_n again.
First timing ABBA has cold first-use contamination. No 28–34% context speedup is claimed.
